A Mother's Love in the Age of AI: HolaHeart's Opening Dialogue

HolaHeart · Stillness & Family · 15 Nov 2026 · 2 min read · HolaRise Coordinating Team

On the afternoon of 15 November 2026 (14:00–16:50) at May Lang Thang Cafe in Hoa Lac, HolaHeart held its opening dialogue on A Mother's Love in the Age of AI.

Phones went face-down on wooden tables for nearly three hours. At a time when artificial intelligence can answer almost any question in seconds, students and young professionals chose to sit face to face and reflect on something no algorithm can replicate: a mother's quiet care and daily sacrifice.

With no stage dividing speakers and listeners, simple stories about home-cooked meals and late-night phone calls brought calm, warmth, and closeness back into the room.
